0022600165.text: The Grizzlies (5-0, 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West, with a 1-0 home record) host the New Orleans Pelicans (1-4, 5th in the Southwest and 12th in the West, 4 games back), who have won their most recent game after losing four straight. Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness), while New Orleans is missing Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and the 2025-26 series was split 2-2, with the Grizzlies losing the last meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
